title: Canonical open-product and support comparisons for localization
statement: Fix a commutative ring $A$. Let $X,Y$ be schemes over a scheme $S$, with structure maps $f,g$, and let $b:B\hookrightarrow X$, $d:D\hookrightarrow Y$ and $c:C\hookrightarrow X$ be closed immersions. Put $U=X\setminus C$, $P=X\times_S Y$ and let $h:U\times_S Y\to P$ be the induced open immersion [def-pc-base-change]. Use the supported-coefficient constructions and supported exterior product [def-pur-supported-exterior-product], and the normalized support-restriction triangle [lem-pur-support-restriction-triangle]. Define the canonical open-product comparison as follows. The isomorphism $U\times_S Y\cong P\setminus(C\times_S Y)$ is the unique isomorphism over $P$ whose composite with the open inclusion is $h$. Support changes use equality of the open complements: $(B\cap C)\times_S D=(B\times_S D)\cap(C\times_S Y)$ as supports, and $(B\cap U)\times_S D$ is the restriction of $B\times_S D$ to the indicated open product. For $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $L\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the comparison $h^*(K\boxtimes^L_A L)\cong(K|_U)\boxtimes^L_A L$ is the composite of the canonical exact-pullback/derived-pullback, monoidal [def-kun-derived-tensor], and projection-composition isomorphisms. Transport derived supported sections through these specified scheme, support and coefficient comparisons. This defines the canonical third-term isomorphism from the product support triangle to $R\Gamma_{(B\cap U)\times_S D}(U\times_S Y,(K|_U)\boxtimes^L_A L)$, and the restriction arrow from $R\Gamma_{B\times_S D}(P,K\boxtimes^L_A L)$ to the same open supported sections. Define the identical constructions with a closed cut $c:C\hookrightarrow Y$ in the second ambient scheme: the open ambient is $X\times_S(Y\setminus C)$, the restricted support is $B\times_S(D\cap(Y\setminus C))$, and the restricted exterior product is $K\boxtimes^L_A(L|_{Y\setminus C})$. More generally, for an open immersion $h:S_0\to T$ and closed supports $B,C\subseteq T$ with restricted supports $B_0,C_0\subseteq S_0$, define the map $S_0\setminus C_0\to T\setminus C$ as the unique map over $T$. Its supported restriction on $B\cap(T\setminus C)$, followed by the canonical exact-pullback composition comparison, is the third-term restriction map between the two support localization rows. Intersections and restricted supports are compared through equality of their open complements.
